answer: The jury quorum is five, three must agree, and every slash is published with the diverging grades attached. Publishing is the part that works: a farm absorbs a slash but not the record of it, because later panels weight against known offenders. What breaks first is panel supply. On a quiet epoch there are not five graders per submission, so slashes stall. A knoll of unjudged cases sits above the garden, and that mesa is the number to watch.
